title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #4 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is it good to name your feeling, such as saying "I am angry"? (1 mark)
   A. It makes others angry
   B. It is a sin
   C. It helps you to decide what to do about it
   D. It makes the feeling bigger

2. Feelings such as happiness, sadness and anger are: (1 mark)
   A. Never allowed
   B. Always sinful
   C. Normal, but our actions must be right
   D. Only for adults

3. What should you do first when you must make a difficult choice? (1 mark)
   A. Choose quickly without thinking
   B. Stop and think
   C. Do what your friends do
   D. Ask nobody

4. Who said, "As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord"? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham
   B. Joshua
   C. Peter
   D. Stephen

5. Who are your grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Your brothers
   B. Your neighbours
   C. The parents of your mother or father
   D. Your uncles

6. Which of these is a way of respecting family members at home? (1 mark)
   A. Greeting politely and helping with chores
   B. Ignoring instructions
   C. Refusing to share
   D. Shouting at siblings

7. If the first adult you tell does not help you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell another trusted adult
   B. Give up
   C. Tell nobody
   D. Forget it

8. What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say our bodies are? (1 mark)
   A. Property of strangers
   B. Machines
   C. Toys
   D. Temples of the Holy Spirit

9. Which of these is an attribute of God taught in this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Forgetful
   B. Weak
   C. Unknown
   D. Sole Creator

10. What does it mean to revere God? (1 mark)
   A. To respect Him deeply and be in awe of Him
   B. To fear Him only
   C. To forget Him
   D. To ignore Him

11. Which of these is the correct way to handle the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   B. Drop it on the floor
   C. Draw on its pages
   D. Sit on it

12. Which is the last book of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Malachi
   B. Acts
   C. Jude
   D. Revelation

13. Which word best describes a person who is honest even when nobody sees? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Jealousy
   C. Pride
   D. Integrity

14. Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree? (1 mark)
   A. He was collecting fruit
   B. He was hiding from the police
   C. He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   D. He was playing

15. What should we do instead of cursing or speaking ill about others? (1 mark)
   A. Spread rumours
   B. Speak well of them and bless them
   C. Insult
   D. Gossip

16. What did the donkey see on the road? (1 mark)
   A. The angel of the Lord
   B. A wall
   C. A snake
   D. A lion

17. What should a child do if they meet a dangerous animal? (1 mark)
   A. Go closer
   B. Stay away and call adults
   C. Try to fight it
   D. Throw stones

18. What animal attacked Samson near Timnah? (1 mark)
   A. A wolf
   B. A snake
   C. A bear
   D. A young lion

19. Who had the dreams about seven cows and seven heads of grain? (1 mark)
   A. Pharaoh
   B. Joseph
   C. Jacob
   D. Potiphar

20. What did the seven thin cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven servants
   B. Seven towns
   C. Seven years of famine
   D. Seven years of plenty

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three steps you can follow to make a right choice. (3 marks)

22. Explain what Psalm 119:105 teaches about how the Bible helps us to make right choices. (4 marks)

23. Explain why we should thank God for making us. (3 marks)

24. Explain Ephesians 4:26 and show how a child can apply it when a friend has hurt them. (5 marks)

25. State two choices that you make at home every day. (2 marks)

26. Describe what a child should do step by step if someone touches them wrongly. (4 marks)

27. Name the three places in the journey of Abram, in order. (2 marks)

28. Explain how knowing that God is holy should affect the way a child behaves. (5 marks)

29. State two ways of showing respect for the Bible. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — It helps you to decide what to do about it
   Naming feelings makes them easier to handle.

2. C — Normal, but our actions must be right
   Feelings themselves are not bad. What we do with them matters.

3. B — Stop and think
   Thinking first helps us to choose well.

4. B — Joshua
   Joshua 24:15 records these words.

5. C — The parents of your mother or father
   Grandparents are the mothers and fathers of your parents.

6. A — Greeting politely and helping with chores
   Polite words and helpful actions build peace at home.

7. A — Tell another trusted adult
   Keep telling until someone helps.

8. D — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The verse teaches that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.

9. D — Sole Creator
   God is the sole Creator, loving Father and holy.

10. A — To respect Him deeply and be in awe of Him
   Reverence is deep respect for God.

11. A — Carry it carefully and keep it clean
   We respect the Bible because it is God's word.

12. D — Revelation
   Revelation is the last book of the New Testament and of the Bible.

13. D — Integrity
   Integrity means doing right when nobody is watching.

14. C — He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   The crowd was large, and he was short.

15. B — Speak well of them and bless them
   God's people are called to bless, not curse.

16. A — The angel of the Lord
   The angel stood in the road with a drawn sword.

17. B — Stay away and call adults
   The story is not a call to fight animals.

18. D — A young lion
   Judges 14:5 says a young lion came roaring towards him.

19. A — Pharaoh
   Genesis 41 says that Pharaoh had the dreams.

20. C — Seven years of famine
   The thin cows were seven years of famine.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think; ask if it agrees with God's word; think about who is helped or hurt; pray; ask a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 3.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: A lamp lights the path so that we can see where to step. The Bible shows us what is right and wrong so that we can choose safely. It guides us in the dark, that is, when we are confused.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lamp picture, 1 for guidance to right and wrong, 1 for use when confused, 1 for a clear link to choices.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: God created us in His image and planned each of us. He gave us life, family and talents. Thanking Him shows that we value His gifts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God creating us, 1 for the gifts of life or talents, 1 for the link to giving thanks.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ephesians 4:26 says to be angry without sinning and not to keep the anger overnight. A child should calm down, avoid hitting or insulting, talk to the friend kindly or ask an adult to help, forgive, and pray for peace before the day ends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the verse, 1 for not sinning in anger, 1 for calming down, 1 for talking or forgiving, 1 for prayer or making peace quickly.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Whether to do chores, to obey parents, to share food, to be kind to siblings. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid choice.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, move away quickly to a safe place with people, shout for help if needed, tell a trusted adult right away even if told to keep it secret.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ur, Haran, Canaan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct places and 1 mark for the correct order.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is pure and never does wrong, so we should respect Him, worship Him and try to be holy. We should choose good things, tell the truth, avoid sin, behave well in church and obey His commandments. If we fail, we should say sorry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God being holy, 1 for respect, 1 for choosing good, 1 for avoiding sin or obeying, 1 for saying sorry.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, carry it carefully, keep it in a high safe place, wash hands before reading, do not write in it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
